symptom: single-write-region read can hang when the application region is not the hub
diagnostic-action: Compare configured application region, write region, retry diagnostics and endpoint routing.
qualification: Candidate SDK-specific hypothesis; reproduce on the deployed version before attribution.

symptom: change-feed processor can fail after a partition split when lease state lacks a feed range
diagnostic-action: Inspect split timing, lease records, processor ownership and SDK version.
qualification: Change-feed-specific; not evidence of a service-wide outage.

symptom: generic 410 handling may involve stale collection routing metadata
diagnostic-action: Correlate 410 substatus, partition-map refreshes and topology changes.
qualification: Investigation record, not a confirmed universal cause.

symptom: background address-cache refresh can raise an unobserved exception with partition failover enabled
diagnostic-action: Check SDK version, PPAF configuration and background exception traces.

symptom: a feed-range query iterator can reject a partition-key range
diagnostic-action: Capture iterator construction, feed range and partition-key representation.
qualification: API-shape case; validate against the exact SDK release.

symptom: metadata hedging may create excess background fan-out and confusing traces
diagnostic-action: Inspect hedge count, concurrency, cancellation and trace parentage.
qualification: Design investigation; do not assume customer request fan-out has this cause.

symptom: cross-region hedge timer disposal can throw during a race
diagnostic-action: Correlate exception stacks with hedging configuration and cancellation timing.
qualification: SDK implementation case, not Cosmos service health evidence.

symptom: cross-partition DISTINCT plus ORDER BY can omit values across pagination
diagnostic-action: Compare query, continuation tokens, partition count and complete expected key set in non-production.
qualification: Query-shape-specific; avoid reading production document bodies during diagnosis.

symptom: cancelled losing hedge can trigger a null request exception
diagnostic-action: Inspect cancellation ordering, PPAF/PPCB and SDK stack traces.
qualification: Client-side hypothesis requiring matching stack and configuration.

symptom: gateway writes may hang with pooled HTTP connections in an emulator scenario
diagnostic-action: Separate emulator from cloud behavior; inspect gateway mode and socket lifecycle.
qualification: Emulator-specific report; never generalize directly to Azure service.

symptom: eager diagnostic serialization may add client overhead even with a no-op sink
diagnostic-action: Profile client CPU/allocation and diagnostic formatting at the deployed SDK version.
qualification: Client performance hypothesis; compare with server-side latency.

symptom: a distributed-transaction 429 substatus may not follow expected retry classification
diagnostic-action: Capture status, substatus, retry count, request charge and transaction phase.
qualification: Fault-injection/distributed-transaction case; ordinary 429s require separate RU analysis.
